name: DeepWiki
summary: AI-generated documentation for public GitHub repositories, with a hosted MCP server that lists a repository's topics, returns its documentation and answers questions about it. The vendor calls the MCP server free and no-authentication-required.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-08, 09-18 and 09-26: MCP initialize on https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp answers 200 with no credentials, server DeepWiki 2.14.3, three tools listed keyless (question tool renamed ask_wiki_question between 09-18 and 09-26). Public repositories only; private ones are Devin, paid.

payments.notes: 2026-09-26: no surface prices a call to the listed server and no keyless request drew a 402; private mode unmeasured. Vendor: DeepWiki MCP is "a free, remote, no-authentication-required service"; its Devin MCP page tables Cost "Free" against "Requires Devin account". Devin plans priced separately.

jobs.summary: A free, remote MCP server that lists a public GitHub repository's documentation topics, returns its generated documentation and answers questions about it (Ask Devin).
